questions: Do you have any memory of waking up and getting out of bed during the night?
Has your bed partner ever observed you eating or drinking while you appear to be asleep?
Do you find food wrappers, crumbs, or dirty dishes in your bed or room the morning after these episodes?
Are you currently taking any prescription sleep medications, such as Zolpidem (Ambien) or Eszopiclone (Lunesta)?
Do you sleep alone, or is there someone who could observe you during sleep?
Has anyone ever mentioned to you that you do strange things in your sleep, such as sleepwalking or talking?
Have you noticed any unexplained weight gain or difficulty managing your weight?
Do you ever wake up with unexplained stomach discomfort or feeling overly full?
Do you take any over-the-counter medications at night, such as antihistamines, diphenhydramine (Benadryl), or melatonin?
Do you use your phone or tablet while in bed before falling asleep?
How long does it typically take you to fall asleep after getting into bed?
Do you have trouble falling asleep, trouble staying asleep, or both?
Do you feel rested and refreshed when you wake up in the morning?
When you do wake up during the night, are you able to fall back asleep easily?
Have you ever noticed that you cannot explain how certain food items or snacks ended up consumed or missing from your kitchen?
Do you eat during the day normally, or have you noticed changes in your appetite?
Are you a light sleeper who wakes easily to noises?
Do you feel anxious or stressed during the day?
Do you have any medical conditions such as diabetes, thyroid problems, or reflux?
Have you ever had a head injury or concussion?
Do you have any family history of seizures or epilepsy?
Have you ever had any episodes during the day where you "space out" or stare blankly?
Do you take any recreational substances or drink alcohol in the evening?
Do you notice any jerking movements of your arms or legs during sleep?
When did you have your head injury - was it recent or in the past?
Did you lose consciousness during your head injury?
Did these strange sleep behaviors start after your head injury, or were they happening before?
How often do these episodes occur - every night, a few times a week, or less frequently?
Do you ever injure yourself during these episodes, such as falling out of bed or hitting furniture?
